documents.title: Quitting check-in
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Melissa, this is the January check-in we talked about. Any thoughts on a quit date? Happy to send in patches and gum if you want to try with some help this time.

documents.title: RE: Quitting check-in
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Ugh, thank you for remembering. Not yet. Work is a mess until spring. I'll bring it up in March.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Routine BP follow-up. Doing well. Home readings at goal. Face pain controlled. Thyroid symptoms none.
Smoking: as promised she raised it. Cut to about half a pack some weeks, then back up. Declines NRT again, wants to do it 'cold turkey' on a vacation week in May.
Exam: heart regular, lungs clear, no edema.
A/P: HTN controlled, BMP today. Other problems stable. Follow-up in summer.

documents.title: Result Note
documents.author: RN
documents.body: BMP normal, pt informed via portal per PCP.

documents.title: No-show Follow-up
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Left voicemail re missed visit yesterday. Pt texted back that she forgot, apologized, will rebook with her fall physical. No issues.

documents.title: Electronic Refill Request
documents.author: MA
documents.body: E-refill request from pharmacy: carbamazepine 200 mg #180, sertraline 100 mg #90. Last labs 03/2024. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Refill Approval
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Approved both, 90-day supply x1 refill. Labs at physical.

reports.text: Screening tomosynthesis mammography, both breasts, CC and MLO projections. Compared with 08/2023 and earlier. Heterogeneously dense tissue. No mass, suspicious calcification or distortion. Skin and nipple contours normal.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual, rebooked after the June miss. Feels well. The May quit attempt held about ten days. Still about a pack a week, frustrated with herself. Discussed that every attempt counts; offered varenicline again, she wants to read about it first.
No palpitations or heat intolerance. TN: two short flares this year that settled on her usual dose. Mood good, PHQ-9 3.
Exam: vitals as charted. Thyroid: small right nodule, unchanged. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Breasts symmetric, no masses, skin normal, no nipple retraction, no axillary nodes. Abdomen soft. No edema.
A/P
1. HTN controlled on lisinopril/HCTZ.
2. S/p I-131 for toxic nodule: TSH today.
3. TN on carbamazepine 200 BID: CMP, CBC.
4. MDD in remission.
5. Tobacco: counseled, info on varenicline given.
6. HM: flu and COVID today. Lipids. Mammogram 9/2024 negative. Colonoscopy 2032. Pap 2027.

documents.title: Result Note
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: All normal: TSH, sodium, counts, liver tests, lipids.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Spring BP check. Fine at home and here. TN quiet. Mood good. Decided against varenicline for now; thinking about patches 'when the weather's nice'. Still about a pack a week.
Exam: heart and lungs normal. No edema.
A/P: HTN controlled. Sodium and counts today for carbamazepine. Physical in October.

reports.text: Bilateral screening mammogram with tomosynthesis. Comparison 09/2024 and prior. Heterogeneously dense. No suspicious mass, calcifications or architectural distortion in either breast. No skin thickening or nipple change.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual. No complaints. BP fine on lisinopril 10 and HCTZ 12.5. Facial pain controlled, one brief flare in the summer. Mood steady, PHQ-9 2. No thyroid symptoms.
Smoking: about a pack a week. Talked again; she says next year, for real. Patches offered, she'll message if she wants them sent.

Exam: vitals as charted. HEENT normal. Thyroid: small right nodule, stable. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Breasts: symmetric, no masses, skin normal without redness or edema, nipples normal, no axillary or supraclavicular nodes. Abdomen soft, nontender. Extremities without edema. Neuro nonfocal. Mood euthymic.

A/P
1. Essential HTN, controlled. Continue.
2. Toxic thyroid nodule s/p I-131 in 2023, euthyroid; TSH today.
3. Trigeminal neuralgia on carbamazepine 200 BID; CMP and CBC today.
4. MDD, in remission on sertraline 100.
5. Tobacco, counseled 5 min.
6. HM: flu and updated COVID given. Lipids. Mammogram 9/2025 negative. Colonoscopy due 2032, Pap 2027.
Refills sent. Next physical in a year, BP check in spring.

documents.title: Result Note
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: TSH, CMP, CBC and lipids normal. Portal message sent.

documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy requesting lisinopril 10 mg and HCTZ 12.5 mg, 90-day supply. Approved per PCP protocol, last BMP 10/2025.
